payload.purpose_context: The events domain's Java services and contracts moved to spec-kitty-events (ADR 2026-10-29-1). This Mission pins the first service-v* release in core, points CI and the conformance tests at the pinned assets, removes core's frozen copies, and makes the release process verify the service pins (#6915 gaps 3 and 11).
payload.purpose_tldr: Core consumes the released, pinned events read service instead of carrying the Java service and contracts in-tree.

payload.question: Which pinned assets does make dev-setup fetch: everything for this host (incl. the ~95 MB read-service binary) or only the extras (fixtures, bundles, tools)?

payload.final_answer: extras only: make dev-setup runs sync-services with --extras-only (fixtures, bundles, tools); make sync-services keeps fetching everything for this host. Resolved from the operator brief (non-interactive dispatch): it asks to add sync-services to dev-setup and keeps the read service off user machines (decision 2); the binary is needed only by the nightly compare and the release check.
